The '''Galactic Empire Embassy''' was the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] embassy to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], that was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].
